title.zh-TW: 大字捲動時從模糊變清楚

summary.zh-TW: 參考 santalarch 的大字敘事：每一行捲進畫面時，從模糊、半透明、偏下的位置，跟著捲動慢慢變清楚、到位。往回捲會再變模糊。
summary.en: Big-type storytelling inspired by santalarch: each line starts blurred, faint and slightly low, and sharpens into place as you scroll. Scrolling back blurs it again.

text.zh-TW: GSAP 可以直接補間 CSS filter。模糊很吃效能，所以只用在少量的大字上，不要整頁每個元素都加。
text.en: GSAP can tween CSS filter directly. Blur is expensive, so keep it to a few large lines rather than every element on the page.

text.zh-TW: 拆成畫面上實際的一行一行，每行各自變清楚，比整段一起變清楚更有節奏。autoSplit 讓視窗變寬變窄時重新拆行。
text.en: Splits into the actual on-screen lines so each one sharpens in turn — more rhythm than the whole paragraph at once. autoSplit re-splits on resize.

text.zh-TW: 文字頂端到畫面下方 85% 開始，底端到畫面中間偏下時全部清楚。也就是讀者讀到那裡的時候，字剛好清楚。
text.en: Starts when the top reaches 85% down the screen and is fully sharp when the bottom reaches 55% — right where the reader’s eyes are.

text.zh-TW: 跟著捲動的動畫用等速，捲多少就清楚多少；scrub: 0.8 讓它稍微落後捲動一點，比較滑順。
text.en: Scroll-linked animation stays linear — sharpness follows scroll exactly; scrub: 0.8 trails slightly behind for smoothness.

text.zh-TW: 同一段裡，下一行比上一行晚一點清楚，閱讀方向和動畫方向一致。
text.en: Within a paragraph each line sharpens a little after the one above, matching the reading direction.
